chosen.description: Stores per-vector message address, data and mask entries in a RAM and emits a message write when a function signals a vector, keeping a pending-bit array for masked vectors.

chosen.name: Address-scrambled RAM
chosen.description: A RAM that passes addresses through a keyed permutation and optionally XORs data with a keyed mask to obscure physical layout; it keeps the array and the scrambling key registers.

chosen.name: Gated D latch (active-high)
chosen.description: A transparent latch that passes D to Q while the enable is high and freezes the last value in its storage node when the enable falls.

chosen.name: Floating-point alignment shifter
chosen.description: Right-shifts the smaller significand by the exponent difference and ORs all shifted-out bits into guard, round and sticky bits, holding the aligned significand and the GRS register.

chosen.name: LED breathing engine
chosen.description: Smoothly ramps a PWM duty value up and down to fade an LED, keeping a PWM counter, a current-duty register, a ramp-step register, a ramp-rate prescale counter and a ramp-direction bit.

chosen.name: Asynchronous SRAM/NOR bus controller
chosen.description: Generates chip-select, output-enable and write-enable strobes with programmable setup, access and hold wait states for external parallel memories, keeping per-chip-select timing registers and a phase counter.

chosen.name: End-around-carry adder
chosen.description: Adds two one's-complement operands and feeds the carry-out back into the least-significant carry-in, holding no state.

chosen.name: State retention controller
chosen.description: Sequences save and restore strobes to retention flip-flops around a power-down, keeping a retention phase register, a save-done flag and a restore-pending flag.

chosen.name: Adaptive voltage scaling monitor
chosen.description: Measures silicon speed with replica-path or ring-oscillator counts and requests voltage up or down steps, keeping a measurement counter, target margin registers and the last adjustment code.

chosen.name: Dual-modulus prescaler
chosen.description: Divides an input pulse stream by either P or P+1 as selected by a mode control, used in front of slower counters; it keeps a small internal state counter and the registered mode select.

chosen.name: Exponent scaling unit
chosen.description: Adds a signed integer to a value's exponent to implement scaleB/ldexp with overflow and gradual-underflow handling, registering the adjusted exponent, shifted significand and status flags.

chosen.name: Outstanding transaction ID CAM
chosen.description: Records the IDs of issued bus transactions and finds the matching slot when a response returns, keeping ID fields, per-slot metadata and allocated bits.

chosen.name: Accumulator-based ALU
chosen.description: Combines an incoming operand with an internal accumulator using a selected operation such as add, subtract, AND, OR or XOR and writes the result back; it keeps the accumulator register and a status register of carry, zero, negative and overflow flags.

chosen.name: Packed SIMD floating-point adder
chosen.description: Performs several narrow-precision floating-point additions in parallel by splitting a wide datapath into lanes, keeping per-lane exponent, significand and flag registers plus a lane-mode configuration register.

chosen.name: Header insertion multiplexer
chosen.description: Outputs words from a header register file first and then switches to the payload stream, keeping the header registers and a phase counter that tracks header progress.

chosen.name: DES Feistel round unit
chosen.description: Performs DES/3DES rounds with expansion, S-box substitution and P-permutation on the right half, keeping left and right half registers, the rotating C/D key halves and a round counter.

chosen.name: Gray-coded input decoder
chosen.description: Decodes a Gray-coded index directly into one-hot outputs, so that a single-bit input change moves the active line without intermediate glitches, keeping a registered copy of the Gray input.

chosen.name: Indexed gather engine
chosen.description: Reads an array of indices from memory and fetches the elements they point to into a dense destination, keeping index pointer, element base, element size and destination pointer registers.

chosen.name: Barrett reduction unit
chosen.description: Reduces a product modulo a fixed modulus by estimating the quotient with a precomputed scaled reciprocal and applying final correction subtractions, keeping modulus, reciprocal, quotient-estimate and residue registers.

chosen.name: Exact divider
chosen.description: Computes the quotient when the divisor is known to divide the dividend evenly using LSB-first modular-inverse multiplication, keeping the divisor inverse, working dividend and quotient shift registers.

chosen.name: SIMD lane-partitioned shifter
chosen.description: Shifts or rotates a wide word as independent 8-, 16- or 32-bit lanes by breaking cross-lane paths according to a lane-size setting, and holds the lane-mode register and per-lane results.

chosen.name: Hamming-distance approximate CAM
chosen.description: Counts mismatched bits between the search key and every stored entry in parallel and flags entries within a programmable distance, keeping key storage, valid bits and a threshold register.

chosen.name: Micro-op cache
chosen.description: Caches decoded micro-operations keyed by instruction fetch address so the decoders can be bypassed, keeping tag, valid, micro-op slot and replacement registers for each way.

chosen.name: Rounding right shifter
chosen.description: Shifts a fixed-point value right by a variable amount and adds a rounding increment derived from the dropped bits, keeping the shifted value and a registered rounding-mode setting.

chosen.name: Paged RAM with bank register
chosen.description: A RAM larger than the address bus can reach, accessed through a window whose upper address bits come from a programmable page register; it keeps the array and the page register.

chosen.name: Schroeder allpass section
chosen.description: Disperses phase without changing magnitude, as used in reverberators, by combining feedforward and feedback paths around a long delay, keeping a circular delay buffer, a pointer and a gain coefficient.

chosen.name: Peekable lookahead FIFO
chosen.description: Lets the consumer read any of the first several queued entries by offset without dequeuing them, keeping the storage array, head and tail pointers and a peek-offset input path.

chosen.name: Device identification ROM
chosen.description: Exposes read-only vendor, part, revision, and feature-capability words at fixed register addresses, keeping the hardwired ID constants and a read-data output register.

chosen.name: Bit-stuffing shift register
chosen.description: Shifts out a serial stream and inserts an extra zero after a run of consecutive ones, stalling the input while it does so, keeping the outgoing shift register and a run-length counter of recent ones.

chosen.name: Halving average unit
chosen.description: Adds two operands with one extra bit of precision and shifts right by one, with selectable round-up or truncation, per lane; it keeps the averaged result register.

chosen.name: I3C dynamic address assignment unit
chosen.description: Runs the ENTDAA procedure, arbitrating on 48-bit provisioned IDs and handing out dynamic addresses, keeping an ID shift register, a next-address register and a table of assigned addresses.

chosen.name: Four-activate window (tFAW) tracker
chosen.description: Limits row activations per rank by holding timestamps of the most recent four ACT commands in a small circular history and a pointer to the oldest one.

chosen.name: Redundancy-steering row decoder
chosen.description: Decodes a row address but compares it against fuse-loaded repair addresses and activates a spare row instead on a match, keeping the repair address registers and their enable bits.

chosen.name: Synchronous binary up counter
chosen.description: Increments a binary count register by one on every enabled clock edge, using a common clock and parallel carry logic; it keeps a single N-bit count register.

chosen.name: Flash-clear valid-bit RAM
chosen.description: A RAM paired with a flip-flop array of per-entry valid bits that can all be cleared in one cycle, making reads of uncleared entries return a default; it keeps the data array and the valid-bit vector.

chosen.name: UART break detector
chosen.description: Flags a line held low for longer than a full character frame, keeping a low-duration bit-time counter and a sticky break-received status bit.

chosen.name: Carry-increment adder
chosen.description: Computes each block's sum assuming zero carry-in and then conditionally increments it when the incoming block carry arrives, with no registers.

chosen.name: DC-blocking filter
chosen.description: Removes the DC offset from a stream with a first-order high-pass recursion, keeping the previous input sample and the previous output sample in registers.

chosen.name: Phase-frequency detector
chosen.description: Compares reference and feedback clock edges and asserts UP or DOWN pulses proportional to their phase difference, keeping the UP and DN flops that are cleared together by a reset path.

chosen.name: Interrupt coalescing timer
chosen.description: Delays and batches interrupt assertions until either an event count or a time limit is reached, keeping an event counter, a holdoff timer and their programmed limits.

chosen.name: Adaptive clock stretcher
chosen.description: Lengthens the next clock cycles when a supply-droop detector fires and restores normal period afterward, keeping a stretch-active flag, a recovery counter and a stretch-amount register.

chosen.name: Keypad matrix encoder
chosen.description: Drives rows of a key matrix in turn, samples columns, and encodes the pressed key's row and column into a key code, storing the row-scan counter, key-code register and key-pressed flag.

chosen.name: Nonlinear feedback shift register
chosen.description: Shifts a register by one position per clock and feeds back a nonlinear Boolean function of selected taps into the input to generate sequences, holding the N-bit state register.

chosen.name: Time-division multiplexer
chosen.description: Steps a slot counter through the inputs in a fixed repeating schedule and forwards the input owned by the current slot, keeping the slot counter and a programmable slot-count register.

chosen.name: Sticky status bit synchronizer with clear handshake
chosen.description: Latches asynchronous status events into a sticky register in the source domain, synchronizes it to software's domain, and clears it via a synchronized clear-request toggle.

chosen.name: PLL lock detector
chosen.description: Declares a clock loop locked or unlocked by watching phase-error samples, keeping a lock state bit and a counter of consecutive in-window samples.

chosen.name: RSA CRT recombination unit
chosen.description: Combines the two half-size exponentiation results modulo p and q into the full RSA result using Garner's formula, storing the partial results, the qInv coefficient and an output register.

chosen.name: DFE tap adaptation engine
chosen.description: Adjusts decision-feedback equalizer tap weights using sign-sign LMS on slicer errors, keeping a coefficient register per tap, a history of past decided bits and a step-size register.

chosen.name: IQ imbalance corrector
chosen.description: Compensates gain and phase mismatch between the I and Q branches by applying a correction matrix to each complex sample, holding programmable gain and phase coefficients and pipelined corrected outputs.

chosen.name: Feedback comb filter
chosen.description: Creates echo or resonance by adding a scaled, delayed copy of the output back to the input, keeping a circular delay memory, its write pointer and a feedback gain register.

chosen.name: Two-phase (NRZ) handshake synchronizer
chosen.description: Signals transfers by toggling a request register in the sender and an acknowledge register in the receiver, each synchronized into the opposite domain through flop chains.

chosen.name: Sparse-tree adder
chosen.description: Generates only every k-th carry with a prefix tree and feeds them to small carry-select blocks that form the sums, keeping no state.

chosen.name: Byte-lane steering multiplexer
chosen.description: Routes each output byte lane from the input byte lane chosen by an address offset and transfer size, holding the registered offset and size that drive the lane selects.

chosen.name: Interrupt rate moderator
chosen.description: Enforces a minimum interval between successive interrupt assertions to a processor, keeping an inter-interrupt countdown and a deferred-pending flag.

chosen.name: Minority gate
chosen.description: Outputs the complement of the majority value of its inputs, with no registers or memory.

chosen.name: Exponential backoff controller
chosen.description: Schedules retransmission after collisions in a shared-medium protocol, holding a collision-attempt counter, a randomly loaded backoff slot counter and a waiting/transmitting state.

chosen.name: Distributed-arithmetic multiplier
chosen.description: Computes a sum of products with fixed coefficients by using the input bits, one bit position per cycle, to address a precomputed table and shift-accumulating the outputs; it keeps the coefficient-sum ROM, input shift registers, an accumulator and a bit counter.

chosen.name: Toffoli gate
chosen.description: A reversible three-input gate that passes two control inputs through and flips the third input when both controls are 1, holding no stored state.

chosen.name: Multi-pop FIFO
chosen.description: Delivers up to several consecutive head entries per cycle from banked storage, keeping a read pointer that advances by the number of words consumed and a write pointer.

chosen.name: Store data steering rotator
chosen.description: Rotates store data up to the byte position given by the address offset and generates matching byte-enable strobes, keeping registered aligned data and the byte-enable vector.

chosen.name: BCD decimal divider
chosen.description: Divides packed-BCD operands digit by digit using repeated decimal subtraction with multiples of the divisor, keeping a decimal partial-remainder, divisor-multiple table, quotient-digit and digit-position registers.

chosen.name: Windowed register file
chosen.description: Exposes a sliding window of in, local and out registers over a large circular physical array, keeping the register contents together with a current-window-pointer and a window-invalid mask used to trigger spill and fill traps.

chosen.name: Full subtractor
chosen.description: Subtracts a subtrahend bit and a borrow-in from a minuend bit, producing a difference and borrow-out, with no stored state.

chosen.name: Data bus inversion encoder
chosen.description: Inverts a byte lane on write when more than half its bits would be driven low and restores data on read, keeping the per-lane DBI flag registers for the current beat.

chosen.name: Snooping bus cache controller
chosen.description: Watches the shared bus for other masters' transactions, looks up their addresses in a duplicate tag copy and supplies data, invalidates or downgrades lines, keeping the duplicate tags and a pending-snoop register.

chosen.name: Elevator controller
chosen.description: Moves a car between floors by serving pending calls, keeping a current-floor register, a direction bit, a pending-request bit vector and a door-state register.

chosen.name: Mesochronous phase-select synchronizer
chosen.description: Captures data from a same-frequency, unknown-phase clock into two alternately clocked registers and uses a calibrated phase-select register to pick the safe one for the receiver.

chosen.name: UART hardware flow control unit
chosen.description: Drives RTS from receive-buffer fill level and gates transmission on sampled CTS, keeping a synchronized CTS register, an RTS output register and programmable assert/deassert threshold registers.

chosen.name: Razor shadow latch
chosen.description: A delayed-clock shadow latch beside a main storage element that recaptures late-arriving data and keeps that sampled bit for comparison with the main value.

chosen.name: Excess-3 adder
chosen.description: Adds two excess-3 coded decimal digits using a binary adder and a correction stage that adds or subtracts three, with no stored state.

chosen.name: Write-strobe demultiplexer
chosen.description: Converts a registered register-bank address and a single write enable into a one-of-N write strobe for the addressed register, holding the captured address and data until the strobe fires.

chosen.name: Bit-field extract/insert unit
chosen.description: Extracts a field of given start position and width from a source word with zero or sign extension, or inserts a field into a destination word; it keeps position and width control registers and a result register.

chosen.name: Johnson-code pointer synchronizer
chosen.description: Encodes a short FIFO or sequence pointer as a Johnson (twisted-ring) code register and synchronizes it through flop chains into the other domain for decoding.

chosen.name: Toom-Cook multiplier
chosen.description: Splits operands into k limbs, evaluates them as polynomials at several points, multiplies the evaluations pointwise and interpolates the result; it keeps evaluation-point registers, pointwise-product registers and an interpolation accumulator.

chosen.name: Clustered register file
chosen.description: Partitions registers between execution clusters, each with a local register file and a small number of inter-cluster copy ports, storing per-cluster register arrays and a pending cross-cluster transfer queue.

chosen.name: LSB-first serial comparator
chosen.description: Compares two operands one bit per clock starting from the least significant bit, overwriting a running relation register whenever the current bit pair differs so the final value reflects the most significant difference.

chosen.name: Link training state machine
chosen.description: Steps a serial link through detect, polling, configuration and active states, keeping a state register, a timeout counter and a count of consecutive training sequences received.

chosen.name: Perceptron branch predictor
chosen.description: Computes a dot product of signed weights with global history bits to predict a branch and trains the weights on mispredictions, keeping a table of weight vectors and a history register.

chosen.name: NOR SR latch
chosen.description: Two cross-coupled NOR gates that set or reset on active-high S and R inputs and keep one stored bit, Q, in the feedback loop while both inputs are low.

chosen.name: Prescaled digit-recurrence divider
chosen.description: Scales the divisor and dividend by a table-derived factor so quotient digits can be selected by simple rounding of the residual, keeping scale-factor, scaled-operand, residual and quotient registers.

chosen.name: I2C bus recovery FSM
chosen.description: Frees a stuck I2C bus by toggling the clock line until the data line is released and then issuing a stop, holding a pulse counter and a recovery-phase state register.

chosen.name: Longest-prefix-match engine
chosen.description: Stores prefix/length entries in parallel comparators and returns the address of the matching entry with the longest prefix, keeping a prefix array, a length array and per-entry valid bits.

chosen.name: Floating-point min/max unit
chosen.description: Returns the minimum or maximum of two operands with IEEE handling of signed zeros and NaNs, keeping a registered result and invalid-operation flag.

chosen.name: SIMD partitioned multiplier
chosen.description: Can be configured to perform one full-width multiply or several independent narrower lane multiplies by breaking carry and partial-product paths at lane boundaries; it keeps a mode register, operand registers and a lane-packed result register.

chosen.name: Threshold gate
chosen.description: Outputs 1 when the weighted sum of its binary inputs reaches a fixed threshold, with no stored state.

chosen.name: FR-FCFS DRAM command scheduler
chosen.description: Picks the next DRAM command from a pending request queue, favoring row-buffer hits and then the oldest request, and keeps per-entry age stamps, target bank/row fields and a ready mask.

chosen.name: Bit-serial associative processor
chosen.description: Searches all words in parallel one bit column at a time, narrowing a per-word response tag, keeping the word array, a comparand register, a mask register and the response-tag register.

chosen.name: Conditional-select unit
chosen.description: Chooses between two operands based on a condition code evaluated against the current flags, implementing conditional move and select instructions; it keeps the selected result register.

chosen.name: QC-LDPC circulant shifter
chosen.description: Cyclically rotates a block of Z soft values by a per-entry shift taken from a parity-check base matrix for a configurable lifting size, keeping the lifting-size register, the shift-value ROM and the rotated block register.

chosen.name: Lattice filter
chosen.description: Filters a stream through cascaded lattice stages, each combining forward and backward prediction errors using reflection coefficients, and stores a backward-error delay register per stage plus a coefficient register file.

chosen.name: Welch spectral averager
chosen.description: Averages power spectra across successive FFT frames by accumulating squared bin magnitudes in per-bin memory, keeping the bin accumulation RAM, a bin index counter and a frame counter.

chosen.name: Error-sinking demultiplexer
chosen.description: Routes inputs to the output named by the select code but diverts any out-of-range select to a dedicated error sink, capturing the offending select value in an error-address register and setting an error flag.

chosen.name: Bang-bang phase detector
chosen.description: Samples the reference clock with the feedback clock (or vice versa) to produce a single early/late decision per cycle, keeping the sampling flop and a registered early/late output.

chosen.name: Zero-crossing pitch estimator
chosen.description: Estimates the fundamental period of a signal by timing the intervals between sign changes, keeping the previous sample sign, a running interval counter and the last measured period register.

chosen.name: Residue number system ALU
chosen.description: Performs addition, subtraction and multiplication independently in several small moduli channels with no carry between them; it keeps one residue register per modulus channel.

chosen.name: Memory bank-steering demultiplexer
chosen.description: Routes each memory request to one of several interleaved banks chosen by low-order address bits, holding a per-bank pending-request register and the decoded bank index.

chosen.name: Increment/decrement unit
chosen.description: Adds or subtracts one or a small constant step from an operand with fast carry handling and produces zero and wrap flags; it keeps the result register and the flag bits.

chosen.name: Random replacement unit
chosen.description: Selects a victim way pseudo-randomly on each fill, keeping a free-running pseudo-random state register and a mask of ways eligible for replacement.

chosen.name: Bit-serial divider
chosen.description: Computes a quotient from serially arriving operand bits using a one-bit subtractor per cycle, keeping a partial-remainder shift register, divisor register, borrow flip-flop and bit counter.

chosen.name: GHASH multiplier
chosen.description: Performs the GF(2^128) multiply-and-accumulate used for AES-GCM authentication, holding the hash subkey H and the running 128-bit tag accumulator.

chosen.name: Rotate-and-mask unit
chosen.description: Rotates an operand by a shift amount and then ANDs it with a mask generated from begin and end bit indices, optionally merging it into a destination; it keeps the mask-bounds registers and the result register.

chosen.name: Zero-overhead loop controller
chosen.description: Executes hardware loops without branch instructions by redirecting fetch at the loop end address, keeping loop start, loop end and iteration count registers for each nesting level.

chosen.name: Fetch target queue
chosen.description: Decouples the branch predictor from the instruction cache by queuing predicted fetch blocks, keeping per-entry start addresses, predicted targets and branch metadata for later resolution.

rule: drop candidates judged a repeat of a kind we have or of an earlier candidate, then random.Random(seed).sample(kept, pick)
